item.title: CVE-2026-13341 · 7.4 HIGH 🌩️ — Prompt Injection and Credential Exposure via Untrusted Analytics Data in Kong Konnect MCP
item.description: A vulnerability exists in the Kong Konnect Model Context Protocol (MCP) server prior to version 1.0.0, which could allow a remote attacker to perform an indirect prompt injection attack and execute unintended API requests.
